backup.production_rule: SPEC-44 Revision 1 (the contract). New definer functions, all search_path empty: _confirm_direct_booking_core (no grant), staff_confirm_direct_booking_v1 / staff_decline_direct_booking_v1 / staff_inquiry_payments_v1 / concierge_resume_cassy_v1 (authenticated), telegram_confirm_direct_booking_v1 (service_role), _repair_bypass_confirmed_v1 (no grant), guard_direct_booking_income_confirm + BEFORE UPDATE OF status trigger trg_guard_direct_booking_income_confirm on transactions. fn_direct_booking_cascade replaced from its LIVE body (md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) 934f4b40af823ca3e74b144698c3910e, read 2026-10-08) minus the confirm leg and its confirmEmail; the void leg is unchanged; search_path public -> empty. DATA: the migration runs _repair_bypass_confirmed_v1() once - production read 2026-10-08 found two bypass-confirmed direct bookings, BD296460 (bd296460-0fd2-434f-aa3a-7e89dc90c14e, Oct 8-11) and 92F94D0E (92f94d0e-008c-4439-9c94-6d48684629da, Jul 12-13, confirmed 2026-09-23); each gets an airbnb_reservations DIRECT: row (on conflict do nothing), its calendar row renamed to cascade-direct-<id>, linked and matched, and one booking_decisions row repair:bypass:<id> (finance_review_id null). No transactions write, no review invented, no guest message. On confirm the core queues one net.http_post to guest-messages {booking_id, tapped:true} with x-cascade-cron-secret read from Vault cascade_cron_shared_secret at call time (never stored). BEHAVIOUR CHANGE: a transactions update to confirmed on a direct_booking row whose booking is still pending now raises confirm_from_inquiries (55000); the admin Finance queue section 1 Confirm on such a row (reviewTransaction) fails until L2 ships - apply SQL first, then functions (L3), then apps (L2/L4). No table, column or policy change. restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: take a fresh backup as the LAST act before the apply and fill both (fill-restore-point.mjs).

feature_flags.name: no_flag_rpcs_unused_until_callers_ship
feature_flags.required_state: None. The new RPCs do nothing until the admin (L2), Telegram/Messenger functions (L3) and staff app (L4) call them. The guard and the cascade change are live at apply: the Finance queue income-row Confirm on a pending direct booking now refuses with the confirm_from_inquiries sentence instead of confirming without a review.

compatibility.evidence: Readers unchanged (no table, column or policy change). Old writer that breaks on purpose: admin Finance queue section 1 reviewTransaction (transactions.update status confirmed on a pending direct booking) now raises 55000 confirm_from_inquiries; L2 hides those rows and moves Confirm to Inquiries. Unaffected and covered by pgTAP inquiry_one_tap.sql: decide_direct_booking / staff_decide_direct_booking_v1 / telegram_finance_decide_booking_v1 (booking confirmed before the income flip), a second income row on a confirmed booking, admin_soft_delete_v1 void, expire_booking_holds_v1, supersede (void only). The cascade no longer sends confirmEmail; the decide path never did (it confirms the booking first), and guest-messages is called with tapped:true by the core.
